name: Forest Noyes
sources: FamilySearch, Washington, County Marriages, 1855-2008 (Forest Noyes and Bertha Simons, Burlington, Skagit County, 2 Nov 1902; licence 22 Oct 1902; arks 1:1:QPMN-B457, QPMR-C8GR)
FamilySearch Family Tree, Bertha E. Simons (LXWM-ZQF), Forest Clifford Noyes (LZLP-2TR) and Harry Henry Harrington (LZ5R-CC4); a shared tree, used as a guide only
notes: Married Bertha Simons at Burlington, Skagit County, on 2 Nov 1902; son of George Noyes and Lottie Smith (Washington county marriages).
The FamilySearch tree gives him as Forest Clifford Noyes, 1882–1939, from a shared tree only. Bertha remarried in 1914.
